reader_flags.reason: Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL/menisci, no cartilage lesion/fluid/marrow edema/bone bruise. Missing_evidence: normal osseous signal alone does not expressly exclude an acute cortical fracture line. Patella alta/trochlear dysplasia/Hoffa maltracking changes do not establish synovitis. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ligaments and preserved meniscal morphology/signal, normal femorotibial/trochlear cartilage, no effusion/popiteal cyst. Missing_evidence: partial-depth patellar ulcers with final unnamed grade2 lack precise depth/extent; no significant marrow signal abnormality is a qualified contusion/acute-fracture exclusion. Synovitis unmentioned.
Only generic Sin anomalías appears. No individual target or structure is informatively assessed; all remain not_mentioned rather than inventing twelve negatives.

Direct complete medial meniscal root tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: intact ACL, normal lateral meniscus and preserved cartilage. Below_threshold: MCL irritation with surrounding fluid but no disrupted-fiber diagnosis, small joint fluid and small Baker cyst; flag MCL irritative-versus-injury interpretation. Missing_evidence: marked tibial marrow edema lacks stated impact cause/acute line assessment. Synovitis unmentioned.

Positive effusion uses clearly pronounced fluid. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: intact ACL/menisci/lateral cartilage, possible initial medial mucoid signal, PF slight irregularity explicitly without a deep defect. Missing_evidence: adjacent MCL fluid alone does not establish fiber integrity or high-grade acute tear; partly higher-grade medial cartilage lacks regional extent despite no full-thickness lesion; thickened synovium lacks inflammatory diagnosis. Normal marrow signal in all compartments supports contusion negative but not explicit cortical fracture exclusion; whole report quotes preserve compartment scope. Baker unmentioned.

Direct synovitis supports positive. Below_threshold: ACL/MCL alternatives are grade-I signal injury or degeneration, with normal collaterals elsewhere. Explicit_absence: no lateral tear. Missing_evidence: explicit no tear of either meniscus conflicts with medial surfacing tear and final consistent-with-tear conclusion; retain medial uncertain with full source. Global articular wear/large osteophytes lack cartilage depth/extent; fluid is ungraded; degenerative marrow edema lacks impact cause/acute fracture assessment. Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal cruciates/collaterals, normal anterior/posterior horns of both menisci, preserved femorotibial cartilage, no fluid, normal popliteal fossa and normal bone form/signal apart from identified tripartite variant. Meniscal negatives use the named horn assessment; flag scope. PF cartilage is not assessed by the variant diagnosis. Retinacular/tendon ganglia and posterior-PCL cyst are not Baker cyst. Synovitis unmentioned despite tendon/fat-pad inflammation.

Explicit_absence: normal menisci/cruciates/collaterals and unqualified normal marrow signal for contusion. Missing_evidence: tiny nonspecific subarticular bone lesion with no notable edema lacks an acute cortical-line assessment. No cartilage surface/depth is assessed by that bone finding or by maltracking/patella alta, so cartilage remains unmentioned; effusion/synovitis/Baker unmentioned. Premural fat-pad edema is not synovitis.

Explicit_absence: intact cruciates/MCL/menisci. Below_threshold: superficial PF fibrillation, minimal possibly physiological fluid and no significant Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: femorotibial slight attenuation with no full-thickness lesion lacks precise partial depth; local no reactive subchondral change does not assess impact edema/acute line across all bone. Chronic possibly traumatic muscle atrophy does not establish bone contusion. Other posteromedial ganglion is not Baker cyst. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci, no lateral/PF defects, no effusion or acute fracture. Below_threshold: degenerative MCL thickening/trace edema and trace Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: focal full-depth medial loss has no region size and diffuse thinning has unspecified depth; reactive marrow edema is not a direct impact contusion. Synovitis unmentioned; small PCL-insertion intraosseous ganglion is not Baker evidence.

Direct extensive medial meniscal tear supports positive. Medial OA positive uses diffuse high-grade loss along both weightbearing surfaces, a qualitative regional-extent inference. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/lateral meniscus, no lateral cartilage defect/acute fracture. Below_threshold: MCL alternatives low-grade sprain or reactive edema, small fluid and trace Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: PF loss/full-depth fissures lack extent; mild synovial proliferation lacks inflammatory diagnosis; reactive tibial edema is not directly impact-related. Redacted impression item does not erase explicit body findings.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: normal ACL/MCL/medial meniscus, lateral degeneration without tear, normal femorotibial cartilage and small fluid. Missing_evidence: PF named ICRSIV establishes depth but not regional extent; final Baker diagnosis with numeric-only 3.5-cm collection lacks moderate/large grade; patellar subarticular marrow alteration lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Normal femur/tibia/fibula signal does not cover the patellar abnormality. Synovial Baker cyst is not synovitis; synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ligaments, including MCL despite mild surrounding fluid. Below_threshold: lateral grade-I degeneration and mild joint fluid. Missing_evidence: bare medial gradeIII lacks direct tear/surface diagnosis; mild tibial subchondral edema lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Direct femoral epicondylar bone bruise supports positive. Explicit_absence: ACL graft expressly intact and global cartilage normal; postoperative status alone does not force ACL uncertainty. Below_threshold: small fluid. Missing_evidence: small medial meniscal remnant after partial meniscectomy does not explicitly assess current/recurrent tear; bone-bruise summary does not specifically exclude a discrete acute fracture line. MCL/lateral meniscus/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci/femorotibial cartilage. Below_threshold: no significant effusion. Missing_evidence: mild-moderate PF thinning lacks precise depth/extent; no underlying bony change is local to the patellar abnormality and not a whole-knee contusion/fracture assessment. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and intact normal-signal menisci. Below_threshold: minimal fluid. Missing_evidence: medial cartilage thinning lacks depth/extent; focal marrow edema lacks impact etiology/acute line assessment and limits the earlier broad homogeneous-bone statement. Lateral/PF cartilage, synovitis and Baker unmentioned.

Direct full-thickness ACL rupture and displaced complex medial meniscal tear support positives. Explicit_absence: intact MCL/lateral meniscus. Below_threshold: small fluid. Missing_evidence: medial full/high-grade cartilage loss lacks region size; relatively well-maintained lateral/PF cartilage is qualified without explicit depth; stress bone change and no sinister marrow changes do not establish impact contusion or exclude acute fracture line. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Lateral meniscal positive uses definite final flipped posterior horn and body finding that most of the horn is absent, a displaced abnormal morphology. Explicit_absence: normal MCL/medial meniscus/medial and PF cartilage. Below_threshold: mild fluid. Missing_evidence: old ACL rupture lacks explicit complete/high-grade fraction; instability/translation does not quantify disrupted fibers. Small focal lateral cartilage thinning-loss lacks depth/extent. Synovitis/Baker/bone injury unmentioned; tibial translation alone does not establish contusion/fracture.

Explicit_absence: normal MCL/lateral meniscus. Below_threshold: medial grade-II internal degeneration. Missing_evidence: ACL partial tear 4-mm thickness does not specify percentage of disrupted fibers; fluid is ungraded; focal tibial attachment marrow edema overrides generic normal-bone-signal statement and lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; cruciate ganglia are distinct.

Definite final chronic complete ACL tear resolves suggestive body wording and supports positive; direct medial oblique tear and moderate fluid positive. Explicit_absence: intact MCL/patellar cartilage. Missing_evidence: no obvious lateral tear is qualified; synovial projections with PVNS not ruled out are not a definite inflammatory diagnosis; no obvious marrow edema is qualified and does not exclude an acute cortical line. Medial/lateral cartilage/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci and no acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: physiologic fluid and no significant Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: no full-thickness medial/lateral defects does not exclude greater-than-half partial loss; near-full PF fissure lacks extent. Synovitis unmentioned. Technique has blank knee/system fields, but exam type states right and no conflicting side appears; preserve template incompleteness without inferring a different knee.

Large joint effusion supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci and no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: unnamed femorotibial gradeII/PF gradeIII lack mapped depth/extent; insertional patellar marrow edema and fibular subchondral cysts lack impact cause/acute-line assessment. Remaining normal bones do not erase these focal exceptions. Synovitis unmentioned; proximal tibiofibular fluid is not the knee effusion grade.

Direct tibial bone contusion and synovitis support positives. Below_threshold: final ACL grade-I injury. Missing_evidence: global irregular cartilage thinning and bare patellar grades3-4 lack depth/extent; fluid is ungraded; PCL avulsion with edema lacks explicit acute timing. PCL injury is not ACL high-grade evidence. MCL/menisci/Baker unmentioned; muscle/popliteal edema and bursitis are not a Baker cyst.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci, no Baker cyst/fracture. Below_threshold: tiny non-significant fluid. Missing_evidence: mild/moderate OA with severe medial/PF foci lacks explicit depth/qualifying region extent; reactive marrow edema does not establish impact contusion. Synovitis unmentioned; popliteus myotendinous ganglion is not Baker cyst.

Direct surfacing horizontal medial meniscal tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus and no fracture/contusion. Missing_evidence: slight three-compartment thinning without full loss does not specify whether partial loss exceeds half thickness or its extent. Effusion/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; parameniscal cyst is distinct. Generic unremarkable patella in conclusion does not erase detailed cartilage thinning.

Direct joint synovitis supports positive. Below_threshold: ACL mucoid thickening without disruption, MCL grade-I sprain and lateral grade-II internal degeneration. Missing_evidence: medial bare gradeIII lacks a direct tear/surface statement; fluid is ungraded; subcortical cyst with adjacent edema lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Cartilage/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci and preserved femorotibial cartilage. Below_threshold: minor fluid. Missing_evidence: mild-moderate PF thinning lacks depth/extent; minor underlying bony change does not establish impact cause or acute fracture status. Normal trochlear cartilage does not erase patellar finding. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Direct radial tears of both menisci support positives, including partial medial root morphology. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: continuous mucoid ACL, normal continuous MCL despite nearby fluid, small joint fluid/Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: unnamed femorotibial gradesIII/IV lack depth/extent; edema/cystic change with possible necrotizing lesion lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Source locates edema in tibia but possible necrotizing lesion in femur; preserve rather than repair. PF congruence alone does not assess cartilage. Synovitis/PF cartilage unmentioned.

Direct complex medial meniscal tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus and other femorotibial/trochlear cartilage, no pathological popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: superficial patellar chondropathy and mild fluid. Missing_evidence: mixed partial/full medial ulcers lack qualifying deep-region extent; suggested reactive subcortical fracture lacks definite acute timing and separate traumatic contusion. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct bone contusion and synovitis diagnoses support positives. Bone-contusion positive is supported by consistent lateral femoral/fibular-head sites even though body proximal tibia versus final distal tibia is inconsistent; flag localization, do not silently repair. Explicit_absence: normal MCL. Missing_evidence: ACL gradeII lacks high-grade fiber fraction; medial tear is only to rule out; fluid is ungraded; bone-contusion diagnosis does not exclude a separate acute fracture line. Lateral meniscus/cartilage/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and preserved meniscal morphology/signal, remaining femorotibial/trochlear cartilage and no popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: superficial PF disease and no significant fluid. Missing_evidence: medial partial-depth ulcers/bare final grade2 lack exact depth/extent; no significant marrow change is a qualified injury exclusion. Synovitis unmentioned.

Below_threshold: ACL myxoid degeneration, medial gradeII/lateral gradeI internal meniscal degeneration. Explicit_absence: no increased fluid. Missing_evidence: mild periligament MCL edema lacks fiber-integrity/high-grade assessment; PF integrity loss/thinning with unnamed type4 lacks region extent; focal patellar marrow edema prevents a global negative from later normal-bone-signal boilerplate and lacks impact/acute-line assessment. Medial/lateral cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci/cartilage, no fluid/Baker cyst/acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: acute MCL grade-I sprain despite moderate surrounding edema; edema amount is not fiber-injury grade. Synovitis unmentioned. Technique blanks preserved; exam type specifies right with no contradictory side.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus and no effusion/Baker cyst. Below_threshold: isolated medial meniscal degeneration without a tear diagnosis. Missing_evidence: PF OA lacks depth/extent. Medial/lateral cartilage/synovitis/bone injury unmentioned.

Direct medial horizontal/oblique meniscal tear and pronounced fluid support positives. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/lateral meniscus and normal compartment cartilage. Missing_evidence: possible deep-MCL partial lesion lacks high-grade fraction; awkward in erster Linie contusional/Bone Bruise wording expresses primary likelihood rather than an unequivocal diagnosis, so keep contusion uncertain and flag language scope. Acute discrete fracture-line status is not addressed. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Below_threshold: explicitly small joint fluid and small Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: collective no noteworthy findings for menisci/ligaments/cartilage/marrow is qualified rather than explicit normal/no target lesion; conservatively retain assessed targets uncertain and flag interpretation scope. This is not a generic missing report. Congenital shallow trochlea is not cartilage loss. Posterior-PCL ganglia are separate; synovial cyst does not establish synovitis, which is unmentioned.

Direct total ACL rupture and degenerate/displaced medial meniscal tear support positives. Likely chronic friction qualifies ACL cause, not total rupture. Medial OA positive uses extensive compartment disease with total cartilage erosion/ICRS4, qualitative region extent. Below_threshold: lateral meniscal degeneration without tear. Missing_evidence: lateral/PF no noteworthy/substantial erosion is qualified without exact depth; fluid lacks amount; degenerative/friction marrow edema and benign hyperplasia lack impact cause/acute line assessment. 11-mm loose body is not cartilage-loss extent. MCL/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Definite medial complex meniscal tear supports positive despite gradeIII degeneration. Below_threshold: mild diffuse ACL signal without described discontinuity, MCL grade-I sprain despite prominent surrounding fluid, lateral grade-I internal degeneration and mild joint fluid. Missing_evidence: focal PF thinning/unnamed typeII lacks depth/extent; subchondral cysts and possible bipartite variant do not establish impact or acute fracture. Medial/lateral cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; posterior-PCL ganglion is not Baker cyst.

ACL positive uses ruptured ligament not traceable to its attachments, interpreted as complete disruption rather than an unqualified bare tear; flag morphology inference. Explicit_absence: normal collaterals/menisci and femorotibial cartilage shape. Missing_evidence: fluid/Baker cyst lack moderate/large amount; medial femoral edema lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. PF cartilage and synovitis unmentioned.

Direct complex tear of discoid lateral meniscus supports positive; discoid morphology alone is not the basis. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: no ACL tear, normal MCL, medial myxoid degeneration without tear, intact medial cartilage and lateral irregularity explicitly without focal defect; small fluid and no Baker cyst/acute fracture. Missing_evidence: full-depth trochlear loss lacks region extent; adjacent subchondral signal change lacks impact cause despite normal background marrow. Synovitis unmentioned.

Moderate joint fluid and moderate Baker cyst support positives. Missing_evidence: suspected horizontal meniscal tear is lateral in body but medial in conclusion, both qualified by calcification interference; both targets uncertain with full source rather than repairing anatomy. PF local advanced disease/deep fissures with grade4 lacks clear qualifying cartilage-loss extent. Benign fibular enchondroma/focal subchondral cysts do not establish or exclude impact/acute line throughout knee. ACL/MCL/medial-lateral cartilage/synovitis unmentioned; calcific menisci do not supply definite tear.

Direct complete ACL tear, surfacing medial oblique tear, significant fluid and tibial bone contusions support positives. Below_threshold: low-grade MCL sprain. Explicit_absence: normal lateral meniscus and no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: medial slight thinning and bare PF fissure grade2 lack depth/extent; subchondral fracture is questionable/suspected. Body versus conclusion differs in extra contusion/muscle locations but tibial contusions are consistent; preserve source. Lateral cartilage/synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/menisci/femorotibial-trochlear cartilage and no fluid. Missing_evidence: partial-depth patellar ulcers with bare final grade2 lack exact depth/extent. Cyst deep to distal semimembranosus and between MCL layers is not identified as characteristic gastrocnemius-semimembranosus Baker cyst; possible regional bursitis is not joint synovitis. Baker/synovitis/bone injury remain unmentioned. Extraneous rectus femoris/iliopsoas wording and probable rotura typo preserved without inferring knee pathology.

Explicit_absence: normal continuous ACL/MCL, normal cartilage signal and no fluid. Missing_evidence: both meniscal horizontal signals are only moderately suspicious for older tears versus degeneration; numeric-only popliteal cyst lacks moderate/large grade; focal residual red marrow description does not assess impact edema/acute cortical line throughout knee. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct displaced complex/radial medial meniscal tear and moderate fluid support positives. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, no femorotibial defects/Baker cyst. Below_threshold: full-depth PF fissures are explicitly small 3-mm areas, under qualifying extent. Missing_evidence: contusion/subchondral edema wording conflicts with explicit underlying reactive marrow edema at the same tear-adjacent sites; impact causation is unresolved rather than accepting the slash term alone. Whole source preserves this causal conflict. Discrete acute fracture line is not addressed. Synovitis unmentioned.

notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned all 600 targets under frozen rubric. No other 065 annotations, gold, legacy/external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal choices and validated exact contiguous original-language quotes, schema and UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. Unfinished work stayed outside initiative. Explicit absence and below-threshold findings distinguished in notes; missing severity/extent/acuity/anatomy and contradictions masked. Only completion/coverage/hashes shared with root; flags withheld pending independent source-first review. Draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
